mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN () THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('FAILED', 'CLOSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalOrders FROM payment_order WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM refund_order WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND DATE(refunded_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM settlement_order WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND DATE(executed_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(platform_fee), 0) FROM clearing_order WHERE settle_date = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_event WHERE verdict = 'REJECT' AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM payment_order WHERE status IN () AND DATE(created_at) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY GROUP BY DATE(created_at)

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success FROM payment_order WHERE DATE(created_at) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY GROUP BY DATE(created_at)

SELECT DATE(refunded_at) AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS amount FROM refund_order WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND refunded_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(refunded_at) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY GROUP BY DATE(refunded_at)
SELECT channel_code AS channelCode, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS amount FROM clearing_order WHERE settle_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY GROUP BY channel_code

SELECT co.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, COALESCE(SUM(co.pay_amount), 0) AS amount FROM clearing_order co JOIN merchant m ON m.id = co.merchant_id WHERE co.settle_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY GROUP BY co.merchant_id, m.merchant_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 10
